notes.title: Update 0.6.55 | Fully re-built Steam version for better performance
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33103105/459cfec1f1b6c1628c0f55146d4a8f10b5d96113.png

Hi Everyone,

As per the feedbacks & suggestions received from the community, we have released a new build for the game.

This is a MAJOR update with the following key changes,

Using completely different technology for the Steam Version.
Delivers more than 5x improved rendering performance.
Almost 100MB lesser download size.
Greatly reduced memory usage.
Lighter to use game window.
Steam overlay Support for Windows platforms.
Mac version doesn't support steam overlay as of now
Optional web-flow for in-app purchases
Only if Steam Overlay Support is disabled in the in-game settings
Improved game layout specifically designed for Desktop.
added support for Linux 64-bit


We appreciate your time in giving us your suggestions and feedback about the game and reporting issues encountered. It really helped us a lot to improve the game for you all!

More new features are coming in future updates! Stay Tuned!

Once again, Thank you for playing Downtown Mafia!
